note: Set A binds the cooking thresholds (full/reduced/no points in lb, oz, kg and g), the 96.00 oz starting-water minimum, the two dinner parties, the three guest teams and the 0–100% score range to the correct entities with faithful quotes. Set B covers the guest-list and container facts that A omits, but it invents a quote ('limited to eight people from each of the three neighboring houses') and misbinds the 8-person limit as per-neighborhood when the rule makes it a total including up to two VIPs; it also misreads the Figure 9 x-axis as percent ('0-20% weight vaporized') with a fabricated axis quote and gives a vague 'linear increase points' value unsupported by the caption-only quote. A's weaknesses are milder: it attributes the 0–100% range to the final dinner-party score rather than the percentage integer scores, and one starting-water quote is a garbled truncation. A is heavily redundant but essentially accurate, so it is the better set.
